commits.subject: Enable Hibernate instrumentation in Spring JPA tests

diagnoses.analysis: This is a downstream status aggregator, not an independent failure. reusable-pr-build.yml fails it when common or test-latest-deps fails. The frozen common and latest-dependency jobs fail because Spring JPA tests do not opt into the newly default-off Hibernate instrumentation. The shared test JVM opt-in fixes the originating failures without changing the aggregator.

The frozen job fails in Hibernate 6.0 SpringJpaTest.testCrud: expected four spans but saw only parent and JDBC because this separate test project lacks an opt-in after the PR makes Hibernate default-off. Add otel.instrumentation.hibernate.enabled=true to its shared Test JVM configuration so normal and experimental variants retain their existing Hibernate span assertions. Local Java 25 normal and deny-unsafe variants pass after the fix; default-off and explicit-enable tests also pass.

The Hibernate ORM and procedure-call modules, Hystrix, and Twilio will now be disabled by default in all modes, matching their existing v3-preview behavior. Selectors and explicit enablement remain supported.

- **Behavior:** Remove preview-dependent defaults from the six modules; preserve their names and aliases.
- **Coverage and docs:** Test default-off and explicit opt-in behavior; update metadata, supported-library documentation, and the breaking-change note.

```properties
-Dotel.instrumentation.hibernate.enabled=true
-Dotel.instrumentation.hystrix.enabled=true
-Dotel.instrumentation.twilio.enabled=true
```
metadata.title: Make Hibernate, Hystrix, and Twilio default-off
